```{r}
# Helper functions

make_mean_sd_string=function(data,round_dec=2,na.rm=FALSE){
  formatting_string=paste0("%.",round_dec,"f")
  temp_mean=sprintf(formatting_string,round(mean(data,na.rm=na.rm),round_dec))
  temp_sd=sprintf(formatting_string,round(sd(data,na.rm=na.rm),round_dec))
  return(paste0(temp_mean," (",temp_sd,")"))
}

make_median_IQR_string = function(data, round_dec = 2,na.rm=TRUE) {
  formatting_string=paste0("%.",round_dec,"f")
  temp_median=sprintf(formatting_string,round(median(data,na.rm=na.rm),round_dec))
  temp_q1=sprintf(formatting_string,round(quantile(data, .25,na.rm=na.rm),round_dec))
  temp_q3=sprintf(formatting_string,round(quantile(data, .75,na.rm=na.rm),round_dec))
  return(paste(
    temp_median,
    " [",
    temp_q1,
    ", ",
    temp_q3,
    "]",
    sep = ""
  ))
}

clean_round=function(data,round_digits=2){
  return(sprintf(paste0("%.",round_digits,"f"),data))
}

recode_cohort_nsd_status = function(data, as_factor = TRUE) {
  out_data = data %>%
    mutate(
      cohort_nsd_status = case_when(
        cohort_nsd_status == "PD NSD" ~ "PD",
        cohort_nsd_status == "HC Not NSD" ~ "HC",
        cohort_nsd_status == "Prodromal NSD" ~ "Prodromal NSD+",
        cohort_nsd_status == "Prodromal Not NSD" ~ "NMC NSD-",
        TRUE ~ cohort_nsd_status
      )
    )
  if (as_factor) {
    out_data = out_data %>%
      mutate(cohort_nsd_status = factor(
        cohort_nsd_status,
        levels = c("HC", "NMC NSD-", "Prodromal NSD+", "PD")
      ))
  }
  return(out_data)
}
```




```{r, include=FALSE}
# Folder containing cognitive assessments, assumed to only have the assessments.
cognitive_assessment_location=r"(C:\Example directory\Cognitive assessments)"

# Adjustment for multiple comparisons.
global_p_value_adjustment="holm"

import_cognitive_list=list()
import_cognitive_files_df = data.frame(files_with_date = list.files(cognitive_assessment_location)) %>%
  mutate(
    date_of_file = sub(".*_(.*)\\.csv$", "\\1", files_with_date),
    files_no_date = sub("_[^_]*\\.csv$", "_", files_with_date)
  )

import_cognitive_correct_cols=list(
  `Benton_Judgement_of_Line_Orientation_` = c("JLO_TOTRAW","PAG_NAME","BENTONVERSION"),
  `Clock_Drawing_`="CLCKTOT",
  `Hopkins_Verbal_Learning_Test_-_Revised_`=c("HVLTRT1","HVLTRT2","HVLTRT3","HVLTRDLY","HVLTREC"), 
  `Letter_-_Number_Sequencing_`="LNS_TOTRAW", 
  `Lexical_Fluency_`=c("LXFLUEF","LXFLUEA","LXFLUES"), 
  `Modified_Boston_Naming_Test_`="MBSTNCRR",
  `Modified_Semantic_Fluency_`=c("VLTANIM","VLTVEG","VLTFRUIT"),
  `Montreal_Cognitive_Assessment__MoCA__`="MCATOT",
  `Symbol_Digit_Modalities_Test_`="SDMTOTAL",
  `Trail_Making_A_and_B_`=c("TMTASEC","TMTBSEC")
)

for(i in import_cognitive_files_df$files_with_date){
  loop_import_name_no_date=import_cognitive_files_df[import_cognitive_files_df$files_with_date==i,"files_no_date"]
  import_cognitive_list[[loop_import_name_no_date]]=read.csv(paste0(r"(H:\251103 - PPMI (Saar)\Cognitive assessments\)",i),
                     colClasses = c("PATNO"="character"))%>%
    select(PATNO,EVENT_ID,all_of(import_cognitive_correct_cols[[loop_import_name_no_date]]))
}

cognitive_list_with_derived=import_cognitive_list
cognitive_list_with_derived$`Hopkins_Verbal_Learning_Test_-_Revised_` =
  cognitive_list_with_derived$`Hopkins_Verbal_Learning_Test_-_Revised_` %>%
  mutate(hvlt_immediate_memory_derived = HVLTRT1 + HVLTRT2 + HVLTRT3) %>%
  select(-c(HVLTRT1, HVLTRT2, HVLTRT3))
cognitive_list_with_derived$Lexical_Fluency_=
  cognitive_list_with_derived$Lexical_Fluency_%>%
  mutate(lexical_fluency_sum_derived=LXFLUEF+LXFLUEA+LXFLUES)%>%
  select(-c(LXFLUEF,LXFLUEA,LXFLUES))
cognitive_list_with_derived$Modified_Semantic_Fluency_=
  cognitive_list_with_derived$Modified_Semantic_Fluency_%>%
  mutate(semantic_fluency_sum_derived=VLTANIM+VLTVEG+VLTFRUIT)%>%
  select(-c(VLTVEG,VLTFRUIT))
cognitive_list_with_derived$Trail_Making_A_and_B_=
  cognitive_list_with_derived$Trail_Making_A_and_B_%>%
  mutate(TMTASEC=ifelse(TMTASEC==4883,NA,TMTASEC))%>% # Remove erroneous value
  mutate(tmt_b_minus_a_derived=TMTBSEC-TMTASEC)

mbnt_boxcox=MASS::boxcox(lm(61-cognitive_list_with_derived$Modified_Boston_Naming_Test_$MBSTNCRR~1))
mbnt_boxcox_lambda = mbnt_boxcox$x[which.max(mbnt_boxcox$y)]

cognitive_list_with_derived$Modified_Boston_Naming_Test_ =
  cognitive_list_with_derived$Modified_Boston_Naming_Test_ %>%
  mutate(
    original_MBSTNCRR = MBSTNCRR,
    MBSTNCRR = -((61 - MBSTNCRR)^mbnt_boxcox_lambda - 1) / mbnt_boxcox_lambda
  )

cognitive_vars_df_all_in_one = reduce(cognitive_list_with_derived, full_join, by = c("PATNO","EVENT_ID")) %>%
  setNames(tolower(names(.))) %>%
  rename(jlo_pag_name=pag_name,jlo_version=bentonversion)

cognitive_vars_considered = colnames(
  cognitive_vars_df_all_in_one %>% select(
    -patno,
    -event_id,
    -jlo_pag_name,
    -jlo_version,
    -original_mbstncrr,
    -semantic_fluency_sum_derived
  )
)

cognitive_vars_to_test =
  cognitive_vars_considered[!(cognitive_vars_considered %in% c("tmtbsec", "hvltrec", "mcatot", "clcktot"))]

cognitive_vars_clean_names = data.frame(original = cognitive_vars_to_test) %>%
  mutate(
    clean_name =
      case_when(
        original == "jlo_totraw" ~ "Benton judgement of line orientation",
        original == "clcktot" ~ "Clock drawing",
        original == "hvltrdly" ~ "Hopkins verbal learning test delayed recall",
        original == "hvltrec" ~ "Hopkins verbal learning test recognition memory",
        original == "hvlt_immediate_memory_derived" ~ "Hopkins verbal learning test immediate memory",
        original == "lns_totraw" ~ "Letter number sequencing",
        original == "lexical_fluency_sum_derived" ~ "Lexical fluency sum",
        original == "mbstncrr" ~ "Modified boston naming test",
        original == "vltanim" ~ "Semantic fluency (only animal)",
        original == "semantic_fluency_sum_derived" ~ "Semantic fluency",
        original == "mcatot" ~ "Moca",
        original == "sdmtotal" ~ "Symbol digit modalities test",
        original == "tmtasec" ~ "Trails a",
        original == "tmtbsec" ~ "Trails b",
        original == "tmt_b_minus_a_derived" ~ "Trails b minus a"
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    composite = case_when(
      original == "jlo_totraw" ~ "composite_visuospatial",
      original == "clcktot" ~ "composite_visuospatial",
      original == "hvltrdly" ~ "composite_memory",
      original == "hvltrec" ~ NA,
      original == "hvlt_immediate_memory_derived" ~ "composite_memory",
      original == "lns_totraw" ~ "composite_executive",
      original == "lexical_fluency_sum_derived" ~ "composite_executive",
      original == "mbstncrr" ~ "composite_language",
      original == "vltanim" ~ "composite_executive",
      original == "semantic_fluency_sum_derived" ~ NA,
      original == "mcatot" ~ "MoCA",
      original == "sdmtotal" ~ "composite_processing_speed",
      original == "tmtasec" ~ "composite_processing_speed",
      original == "tmtbsec" ~ NA,
      original == "tmt_b_minus_a_derived" ~ "composite_executive"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Assumed to be in the default working directory.
import_ppmi=read_excel("PPMI_Curated_Data_Cut_INTERNAL_20260511.xlsx")

ppmi_not_filtered = import_ppmi %>%
  setNames(tolower(names(.))) %>%
  mutate(cohort = factor(
    cohort,
    levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
    labels = c("PD", "HC", "SWEDD", "Prodromal")
  ),
  orthostasis=as.logical(orthostasis),
  sex=factor(sex,levels=c(0,1),labels=c("Female","Male")),
  race=factor(race,levels=1:4,labels=c("White","Black","Asian","Other")),
  nsd_status=factor(nsd_status,levels=0:1,labels=c("Not NSD","NSD")),
  hvlt_derived_mean=
    rowMeans(cbind(hvlt_immediaterecall, hvlt_retention, hvltrdly, hvltrec), na.rm = TRUE),
  dvt_fas_and_sftanim_mean= rowMeans(cbind(dvt_fas, dvs_sftanim), na.rm = TRUE)
  )%>%
  group_by(patno)%>%
  mutate(yrs_since_first_visit=age_at_visit-min(age_at_visit))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("original_", .x), any_of(cognitive_vars_considered))%>%
  left_join(cognitive_vars_df_all_in_one,by=c("patno","event_id"))%>%
  filter(!(cohort=="Prodromal" & !is.na(duration_yrs)))

ppmi_to_z_score=ppmi_not_filtered%>%
  filter((cohort == "PD" & subgroup == "Sporadic PD" & nsd_status == "NSD") |
           (cohort == "HC" & subgroup == "Healthy Control" & nsd_status == "Not NSD") |
           (cohort == "Prodromal" &
              ((nsd_status == "NSD" & subgroup %in% c("RBD", "Hyposmia")) |
                 (nsd_status == "Not NSD" &
                    subgroup %in% c("GBA", "LRRK2"))
              )),
         age>=50,
         age<=85,
         educyrs>=7
  )%>%
  mutate(
    cohort_nsd_status =
      factor(
        paste0(cohort, " ", nsd_status),
        levels = c("HC Not NSD", "PD NSD", "Prodromal Not NSD", "Prodromal NSD")
      ),
    event_id = factor(
      event_id,
      levels = c(
        "BL",
        "V04",
        "V06",
        "V08",
        "V10",
        "V12",
        "V13",
        "V14",
        "V15",
        "V16",
        "V17",
        "V18",
        "V19",
        "V20",
        "V21",
        "V22",
        "PW",
        "ST"
      )
    ),
    original_apoe_e4=apoe_e4,
    apoe_e4 = ifelse(apoe_e4 ==0,FALSE,TRUE) # combine 1 and 2 into TRUE
  )

composite_scores_to_test = c(
  "composite_processing_speed",
  "composite_executive",
  "composite_memory",
  "composite_visuospatial",
  "composite_language"
)

ppmi_to_z_score_first_visit=ppmi_to_z_score%>%
  group_by(patno)%>%
  slice_min(age_at_visit, with_ties=FALSE)%>%
  ungroup()
```

# Robust HC z-scoring

```{r}
set.seed(1)

ppmi_hc_for_z_scores_calc=ppmi_to_z_score%>%
  filter(cohort=="HC",year %in% 0:1)%>%
  select(patno,year,moca)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=year,values_from=moca,names_prefix="moca")%>%
  mutate(moca_dif=moca1-moca0,include=(moca0>=27&moca1>=26&moca_dif>=-2))

ppmi_hc_for_z_scores_ids=ppmi_hc_for_z_scores_calc%>%
  filter(include)%>%
  pull(patno)

ppmi_robust_hc_bl=ppmi_to_z_score_first_visit%>%
  filter(patno %in% ppmi_hc_for_z_scores_ids)

z_score_models_full=list()
z_score_models_reduced=list()
z_score_model_table=list()
z_score_reduced_models_rmse=list()
```

Robust HC missing data.

```{r}
naniar::vis_miss(ppmi_robust_hc_bl%>%select(age,educyrs,sex,all_of(cognitive_vars_to_test)))+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90,vjust=0.5))
```

```{r}
for(i in cognitive_vars_to_test){
  loop_df=ppmi_robust_hc_bl%>%
    mutate(age_centered=age-mean(age),educyrs_centered=educyrs-mean(educyrs))%>%
    select(all_of(i),age_centered,educyrs_centered,sex)%>%
    na.omit()
  
  # Initially tried including covariates matching Robust HC paper, but reverted to intercept only model for all to avoid double-correcting.
  # If desired, change p_val below to a non-zero value to restore z-scoring with covariates.
  z_score_models_full[[i]]=lm(as.formula(paste0(i,"~age_centered+educyrs_centered+sex+I(age_centered^2)+I(educyrs_centered^2)")),data=loop_df)
  z_score_models_reduced[[i]]=try(olsrr::ols_step_backward_p(z_score_models_full[[i]],p_val=0),silent=TRUE)
  # Above errors if no predictors chosen by step-wise, which is why we try() it.
  if(inherits(z_score_models_reduced[[i]], "try-error") || is.null(z_score_models_reduced[[i]]$model)) {
    z_score_models_reduced[[i]] <- lm(as.formula(paste(i, "~ 1")), data = loop_df)
  } else {
    z_score_models_reduced[[i]] <- z_score_models_reduced[[i]]$model
  }
  
  z_score_model_table[[i]] = c(outcome = i, n = nrow(loop_df), drop(
    coef(z_score_models_reduced[[i]])
  ))
  
  predict_error = predict(
    z_score_models_reduced[[i]],
  ) - loop_df %>% pull(all_of(i))
  z_score_reduced_models_rmse[[i]]=(mean(predict_error^2))^0.5
}

z_score_model_df=bind_rows(lapply(z_score_model_table, as.list))

ppmi_z_scored=ppmi_to_z_score

for(i in cognitive_vars_to_test){
  loop_df_for_zscores=ppmi_z_scored%>%
    mutate(age_centered=age-mean(ppmi_robust_hc_bl$age),educyrs_centered=educyrs-mean(ppmi_robust_hc_bl$educyrs))%>%
    select(all_of(i),age_centered,educyrs_centered,sex)
  loop_predictions = predict(
    z_score_models_reduced[[i]],
    loop_df_for_zscores
  )
  ppmi_z_scored[,paste0(i,"_z_scored")]=((ppmi_z_scored%>%pull(all_of(i)))-loop_predictions)/z_score_reduced_models_rmse[[i]]
  ppmi_z_scored[,paste0(i,"_z_scored")]=pmax(pmin(ppmi_z_scored[,paste0(i,"_z_scored")][[1]], 3), -3)
}
ppmi_z_scored = ppmi_z_scored %>% mutate(
  tmtasec_z_scored = -tmtasec_z_scored, # match direction (high better) for all cols
  tmt_b_minus_a_derived_z_scored = -tmt_b_minus_a_derived_z_scored
)

cognitive_vars_z_scored=paste0(cognitive_vars_to_test,"_z_scored")
```

```{r,include=FALSE}
ppmi_with_composite_z_scores=ppmi_z_scored%>%
  mutate(composite_processing_speed=(sdmtotal_z_scored+tmtasec_z_scored)/2,
         composite_executive=
           (tmt_b_minus_a_derived_z_scored+lns_totraw_z_scored+vltanim_z_scored+lexical_fluency_sum_derived_z_scored)/4,
         composite_memory=(hvlt_immediate_memory_derived_z_scored+hvltrdly_z_scored)/2,
         composite_visuospatial=jlo_totraw_z_scored,
         composite_language=mbstncrr_z_scored)

ppmi_bl_apoe_impute=ppmi_with_composite_z_scores%>%filter(year==0)


apoe_e4_correlations = ppmi_bl_apoe_impute %>%
  select(where(is.numeric),apoe_e4) %>%
  select(!where(~length(unique(.x))==1))%>%
  relocate(apoe_e4) %>% 
  cor(use = "pairwise", method = "spearman")%>%
  as.data.frame()%>%
  rownames_to_column("variable")%>%
  filter(variable=="apoe_e4")%>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x))))%>%
  select(-variable,-apoe_e4,-original_apoe_e4)%>%
  select(where(~abs(.x)>0.1))

set.seed(1)

ppmi_bl_to_mice = ppmi_bl_apoe_impute %>%
  select(
    patno,
    all_of(c(
      colnames(apoe_e4_correlations), cognitive_vars_to_test
    )),
    age,
    sex,
    bmi,
    duration_yrs,
    educyrs,
    ledd,
    moca,
    orthostasis,
    updrs3_score,
    scopa,
    apoe_e4,
    -abeta_ulod,
    cohort_nsd_status
  )%>%mice::mice()
ppmi_bl_miced =  ppmi_bl_to_mice%>%
  complete()

ppmi_use=ppmi_with_composite_z_scores%>%rename(pre_imputation_apoe_e4=apoe_e4,original_educyrs=educyrs)%>%
  left_join(ppmi_bl_miced%>%select(patno,apoe_e4,educyrs),by="patno")%>%
  filter(patno %in% ppmi_bl_apoe_impute$patno)%>%
  arrange(patno,year)
ppmi_use_first_visit=ppmi_use%>%filter(year==0)

ppmi_use_moca_year1=ppmi_use%>%filter(year==1)
ppmi_use_moca_trends=ppmi_use%>%
  filter(year %in% 1:4)
```

# Trend over time (groups)

```{r}
trend_model_fun=function(data=ppmi_use_trends,
                         vars_to_test,
                         covariates="~age+sex+educyrs+apoe_e4+year",
                         year_var="year",
                         split_var="cohort_nsd_status",
                         bl_group_min=50,
                         categorical_year=FALSE,
                         primary_contrasts = c(
                                    "HC Not NSD year0 - Prodromal NSD year0",
                                    "PD NSD year0 - Prodromal NSD year0",
                                    "HC Not NSD year_as_factor0 - Prodromal NSD year_as_factor0",
                                    "PD NSD year_as_factor0 - Prodromal NSD year_as_factor0",
                                    "HC Not NSD - Prodromal NSD",
                                    "PD NSD - Prodromal NSD",
                                    "PD NSD vs Prodromal NSD",
                                    "HC Not NSD vs Prodromal NSD"
                                  ),
                         adjustment_method = global_p_value_adjustment
                         ){

  data=data%>%mutate(year_as_factor=as.factor(year)) # If swap to categorial

  formula=paste0(covariates,"*",split_var)

  trend_lmer_list=list()
  trend_emmeans_list=list()
  trend_bl_comp_list=list()
  trend_emtrends_list=list()
  trend_anova_list=list()
  trend_lmer_table_summary=data.frame()
  trend_plots=list()

  trend_table_list=list()

  for(i in vars_to_test){
    loop_included_ids=data%>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[i]]),!is.na(.data[[split_var]]),
             year==min(year)
      )%>%
      group_by(.data[[split_var]])%>%
      filter(n()>=bl_group_min)%>%
      ungroup()%>%
      pull(patno)%>%
      unique()

    loop_included_years=data%>% # Limit years so all included groups have >=50 participants.
      filter(!is.na(.data[[i]]),!is.na(.data[[split_var]]),patno %in% loop_included_ids)%>%
      group_by(.data[[split_var]],year)%>%
      summarize(n=n())%>%
      ungroup()%>%
      group_by(year)%>%
      summarize(min_per_year=min(n),n_groups=n())%>%
      filter(min_per_year>=bl_group_min,n_groups==max(n_groups))%>% # Possbily could skip years if n drops one year, but doesn't happen here.
      pull(year)


    loop_df = data %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(.data[[i]]),
        !is.na(.data[[split_var]]),
        patno %in% loop_included_ids,
        year %in% loop_included_years
      )%>%
      mutate(cohort_nsd_status=as.character(cohort_nsd_status),
             year_as_factor=as.factor(as.character(year_as_factor)))

    loop_df_n=loop_df%>%
      group_by(.data[[split_var]],year)%>%
      summarize(n=sum(!is.na(.data[[i]])))%>%
      ungroup()

    if(i=="composite_visuospatial"){
      trend_lmer_list[[i]]=geeglm(as.formula(paste0(i,formula,"+jlo_version")),id=patno,data=loop_df)
    }else if (i=="original_mbstncrr"){
      trend_lmer_list[[i]]=geeglm(as.formula(paste0("cbind(",i,",60-",i,")",formula)),id=patno,data=loop_df,family="binomial")
    } else{
      trend_lmer_list[[i]]=geeglm(as.formula(paste0(i,formula)),id=patno,data=loop_df)
    }
    
    if(categorical_year){
      check_years=as.factor(loop_included_years)
    } else{
      check_years=loop_included_years
    }

    trend_emmeans_list[[i]]=emmeans(trend_lmer_list[[i]],
                                    as.formula(paste0("~",split_var,"*",year_var)),
                                    type="response",
                                    pbkrtest.limit = Inf,
                                    at=list(check_years)%>% setNames(year_var)
    )
    
    if(categorical_year){
      loop_bl_comp_min_year=list(min(loop_df$year) %>% as.character()) %>% setNames(year_var)
    } else{
      loop_bl_comp_min_year=list(min(loop_df$year)) %>% setNames(year_var)
    }
    
    trend_bl_comp_list[[i]] = emmeans(
      trend_lmer_list[[i]],
      as.formula(paste0("~", split_var, "*", year_var)),
      type = "response",
      pbkrtest.limit = Inf,
      at = loop_bl_comp_min_year
    ) %>%
      pairs(adjust="none") %>%
      as.data.frame()%>%
      split_p_val_correction(primary_contrasts=primary_contrasts,adjustment_method=adjustment_method)
    
    if(!categorical_year) {
      trend_emtrends_list[[i]] = emtrends(
        trend_lmer_list[[i]],
        split_var,
        var = year_var,
        type = "response",
        pbkrtest.limit = Inf
      ) %>%
        pairs(adjust="none") %>%
        as.data.frame()%>%
        split_p_val_correction(primary_contrasts = primary_contrasts,adjustment_method=adjustment_method)
    } else{
      unadjusted_categorical_interaction=data.frame()
      for(j in combn(unique(trend_lmer_list[[i]]$data%>%pull(all_of(split_var))), 2, simplify = FALSE)){
        loop_categorical_joint_tests=
          emmeans(trend_lmer_list[[i]],
                  as.formula(paste0("~", split_var, "*", year_var)),
                  type = "response",
                  pbkrtest.limit = Inf,
                  at=list(temp_name=j)%>%setNames(split_var))%>%
          joint_tests()
        loop_interaction_test=loop_categorical_joint_tests%>%
          as.data.frame()%>%
          filter(str_detect(`model term`,":"))%>%
          mutate(contrast=paste0(j,collapse =" vs "))%>%
          relocate(contrast)
        unadjusted_categorical_interaction=bind_rows(unadjusted_categorical_interaction,loop_interaction_test)
      }
      trend_emtrends_list[[i]]=unadjusted_categorical_interaction%>%
        select(-`model term`)%>%
        split_p_val_correction(primary_contrasts = primary_contrasts,adjustment_method=adjustment_method)
    }

    

    trend_df_for_plot=trend_emmeans_list[[i]]%>%as.data.frame()
    if (i=="original_mbstncrr") trend_df_for_plot=trend_emmeans_list[[i]]%>%as.data.frame()%>%rename(emmean=prob)
    trend_plots[[i]] = ggplot(data = trend_df_for_plot,
                              aes(
                                x = .data[[year_var]],
                                y = emmean,
                                color = .data[[split_var]],
                                group = .data[[split_var]]
                              ))+
      geom_point(show.legend = TRUE)+
      geom_line(show.legend = TRUE)+
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lower.CL,ymax=upper.CL),width=0.5)+
      theme_bw()+
      theme(legend.position="bottom",legend.title = element_blank())+
      xlab("Years Since Baseline")+
      ylab(i)

    trend_anova_list[[i]]=joint_tests(trend_lmer_list[[i]])%>%
      as.data.frame()%>%
      mutate(p.value=as.character(signif(p.value,3)),across(where(is.numeric),~clean_round(.x,round_digits=1)))

    loop_clean_emmeans_df=trend_df_for_plot%>%
      mutate(clean_emmean=clean_round(emmean,round_digits=2),
             clean_se=clean_round(SE,round_digits=2),
             emmean_se=paste0(clean_emmean," (",clean_se,")"))%>%
      select(all_of(split_var),all_of(year_var),emmean_se)

    trend_table_list[[i]]=loop_clean_emmeans_df%>%
      mutate(across(all_of(year_var),~as.numeric(as.character(.x))))%>%
      full_join(loop_df_n,by=c(split_var,"year")%>%setNames(c(split_var,year_var)))%>%
      pivot_wider(names_from=all_of(year_var),values_from=c(n, emmean_se))
  }

  return(list(lmers=trend_lmer_list,
              emmeans=trend_emmeans_list,
              bl_comp=trend_bl_comp_list,
              emtrends=trend_emtrends_list,
              anovas=trend_anova_list,
              tables=trend_table_list,
              plots=trend_plots
  ))
}

split_p_val_correction = function(data,
                                  primary_contrasts = c(
                                    "HC Not NSD year0 - Prodromal NSD year0",
                                    "PD NSD year0 - Prodromal NSD year0",
                                    "HC Not NSD year_as_factor0 - Prodromal NSD year_as_factor0",
                                    "PD NSD year_as_factor0 - Prodromal NSD year_as_factor0"
                                  ),
                                  adjustment_method = global_p_value_adjustment
                                  ) {
  adjust_primary_comparison = data %>%
    filter(contrast %in% primary_contrasts) %>%
    mutate(
      p.value = p.adjust(p.value, method = adjustment_method),
      comparison = "primary"
    )
  
  adjust_secondary_comparison = data %>%
    filter(!(contrast %in% primary_contrasts)) %>%
    mutate(
      p.value = p.adjust(p.value, method = adjustment_method),
      comparison = "secondary"
    )
  
  combined_comparison_adjustment = bind_rows(adjust_primary_comparison, adjust_secondary_comparison) %>%
    mutate(
      across(any_of(c(
        "estimate", "SE", "odds.ratio"
      )), ~ clean_round(.x, round_digits = 3)),
      across(any_of(c("df", "t.ratio")), ~ clean_round(.x)),
      p.value = as.character(signif(p.value, digits = 3))
    )
  
  return(combined_comparison_adjustment)
}
```

# Assessing linearity of group trends

These are fit with covariates of age, sex, educyrs, and apoe_e4. Trend is modelled with interactions by group as either with linear and numeric or as categorical. Visuospatial also includes a term for jlo_version.

```{r}
assess_linearity_fun=function(models,
                              formula="age + sex + educyrs + apoe_e4 +",
                              group_var="cohort_nsd_status"){
  
  qic_df=data.frame()
  for(i in names(models)){
    loop_df=models[[i]]$data%>%
      mutate(year_as_factor=factor(year))
    linear_formula=as.formula(paste0(i,"~",formula,group_var,"*year"))
    categorical_formula=as.formula(paste0(i,"~",formula,group_var,"*year_as_factor"))
    if(i=="composite_visuospatial"){
      linear_formula=as.formula(paste0(i,"~",formula,group_var,"*year+jlo_version"))
      categorical_formula=as.formula(paste0(i,"~",formula,group_var,"*year_as_factor+jlo_version"))
    }
    linear_model=geeglm(linear_formula,data=loop_df,id=patno)
    categorical_model=geeglm(categorical_formula,data=loop_df,id=patno)
    qic_df[i,"Linear QIC"]=QIC(linear_model)[["QIC"]]
    qic_df[i,"Categorical QIC"]=QIC(categorical_model)[["QIC"]]
  }
  qic_df=qic_df%>%
    rownames_to_column("Outcome")%>%
    mutate(`Preferred fit`=ifelse(`Linear QIC`<`Categorical QIC`,"Linear","Categorical"))%>%
    mutate(across(contains("QIC"),~clean_round(.x,round_digits=0))           )
  return(qic_df)
}

```

For group comparison:

```{r}
assess_linearity_fun(group_trend_results$lmers)%>%flextable()
```

For stages comparison:

```{r}
assess_linearity_fun(stages_trend_results$lmers,group_var="bl_nsd_stage")%>%flextable()
```

## Trends (by group)

```{r,fig.height=8,fig.width=8}
clean_trend_plots_fun=function(models,year_var="year",split_var="cohort_nsd_status",
                               plot_linewidth=0.5,ymin=-1.25,ymax=0.15){
  
  score_names =
    rbind(
      c("composite_processing_speed","Processing Speed CSS"),
      c("composite_executive", "Executive CSS"),
      c("composite_memory", "Verbal Memory CSS"),
      c("composite_visuospatial", "Visuospatial CSS"),
      c("composite_language", "Language CSS")
    )%>%
    as.data.frame()%>%
    setNames(c("original","clean"))
  
  out_plot_list=list()
  for(i in names(models)){
    if(year_var=="year_as_factor"){
      years_to_plot=list(year=as.character(0:max(models[[i]]$data%>%pull(year))))
    } else{
      years_to_plot=list(year=0:max(models[[i]]$data%>%pull(year)))
    }
    
    loop_df=emmeans(models[[i]],as.formula(paste0("~",split_var,"*",year_var)),pbkrtest.limit = Inf,
                    at=years_to_plot)%>%
      as.data.frame()
    if(split_var=="cohort_nsd_status"){
      loop_df=loop_df%>%recode_cohort_nsd_status()
    }
    out_plot_list[[i]]=
      ggplot(data=loop_df,
             aes(x=.data[[year_var]],y=emmean,color=.data[[split_var]],group=.data[[split_var]]))+
      geom_line(linewidth = plot_linewidth, show.legend = TRUE) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=emmean-SE,ymax=emmean+SE),linewidth=plot_linewidth,width=0.15,show.legend = TRUE)+
      geom_point(size=2,show.legend = TRUE)+
      theme_bw()+
      theme(legend.position="bottom",legend.title = element_blank())+
      xlab("Years Since Baseline")+
      ylab(score_names[score_names$original==i,"clean"])+
      labs(tag=LETTERS[which(names(models)==i)])+
      guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=1))+
      ylim(ymin,ymax)
    if(year_var!="year_as_factor"){
      out_plot_list[[i]]=out_plot_list[[i]]+
        scale_x_continuous(breaks=0:max(models[[i]]$data%>%pull(year)))
    }
    
    
    if(split_var=="cohort_nsd_status"){
      out_plot_list[[i]] = out_plot_list[[i]] +
        scale_color_manual(
          values = c(
            `HC` = "steelblue4",
            `NMC NSD-` = "#E69F00",
            `Prodromal NSD+` = "#D55E00",
            `PD` = "#882255"
          ),
          drop = FALSE
        )
    } else if (split_var=="bl_nsd_stage"){
      out_plot_list[[i]] = out_plot_list[[i]] +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("#6BAED6", "#3182BD", "#08519C", "#08306B"))
    }
  }
  return(out_plot_list)
}

clean_trend_plots=clean_trend_plots_fun(group_trend_results$lmers)
clean_categorical_trend_plots=clean_trend_plots_fun(group_trend_categorical_results$lmers,
                                                    year_var="year_as_factor")
```

```{r}
clean_trend_plots_mci=ggplot(
  data = mci_gee_emmeans %>% as.data.frame() %>% recode_cohort_nsd_status(),
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = prob,
    color = cohort_nsd_status,
    group = cohort_nsd_status
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = prob - SE, ymax = prob + SE),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    width = 0.15,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2, show.legend = TRUE) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      `HC` = "steelblue4",
      `NMC NSD-` = "#E69F00",
      `Prodromal NSD+` = "#D55E00",
      `PD` = "#882255"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  xlab("Years Since Baseline") +
  ylab("MCI Probability") +
  labs(tag = "F") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:4)+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent)
```

## Data count figure

```{r,fig.height=6,fig.width=6}
supplement_count_df = ppmi_use %>% 
  filter(year <= 5) %>% 
  group_by(cohort_nsd_status, year) %>%
  summarize(across(all_of(
    c(composite_scores_to_test, "mci_testscores")
  ),  ~ sum(!is.na(.x))))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(cohort_nsd_status=case_when(
    cohort_nsd_status=="PD NSD"~"PD",
    cohort_nsd_status=="HC Not NSD"~"HC",
    TRUE~cohort_nsd_status
  ),
  cohort_nsd_status=
    factor(cohort_nsd_status,levels=c("HC","Prodromal Not NSD","Prodromal NSD","PD"))
  )

supplement_count_df_long=supplement_count_df%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=-c(cohort_nsd_status,year),names_to="metric",values_to="count")%>%
  mutate(metric=str_to_title(str_replace_all(metric,"_"," ")),
         metric=ifelse(metric=="Mci Testscores","MCI",metric))%>%
  mutate(
    metric = case_when(
      metric == "Composite Executive" ~ "Executive Function",
      metric == "Composite Language" ~ "Language",
      metric == "Composite Memory" ~ "Verbal Memory",
      metric == "Composite Visuospatial" ~ "Visuospatial Function",
      metric == "MCI" ~ "MCI Status",
      metric == "Composite Processing Speed" ~ "Processing Speed"
    ),
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = c(
        "Processing Speed",
        "Executive Function",
        "Verbal Memory",
        "Visuospatial Function",
        "Language",
        "MCI Status"
      )
    )
  )

ggplot(data=supplement_count_df_long%>%recode_cohort_nsd_status(),aes(x=year,y=count,color=cohort_nsd_status,group=cohort_nsd_status))+
  geom_line(linewidth=0.5)+
  geom_point(size = 2)+
  facet_wrap(vars(metric))+
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      `HC` = "steelblue4",
      `NMC NSD-` = "#E69F00",
      `Prodromal NSD+` = "#D55E00",
      `PD` = "#882255"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  )+
  ylab("Total Participants with Data")+
  xlab("Years Since Baseline")+
  geom_hline(yintercept=50,linetype="dashed")
  
# ggsave("ppmi_count_by_outcome.png",dpi=600,height=6,width=6)

supplement_count_df_wide_by_year = supplement_count_df_long %>%
  relocate(metric) %>%
  mutate(year=paste0("Year ",year))%>%
  recode_cohort_nsd_status()%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = count) %>%
  arrange(metric, cohort_nsd_status) %>%
  rename(Group = cohort_nsd_status,Outcome=metric)

flextable(supplement_count_df_wide_by_year)
```

```{r}
emmeans(group_trend_categorical_results$lmers$composite_memory,~cohort_nsd_status|year_as_factor)%>%
  pairs(adjust="none",reverse=TRUE)%>%
  confint()

  confint()

  mci_gee_model,
  "cohort_nsd_status",
  var = "year",
  type = "response"
)%>%pairs(adjust="none",reverse=TRUE)%>%
  confint()%>%
  as.data.frame()%>%
  select(contrast,estimate,contains("CL"))%>%
  mutate(across(!contrast,~exp(.x)))

emmeans(mci_gee_model,~cohort_nsd_status*year,at=list(year=0),type="response")%>%
  pairs(adjust="none")%>%confint()
```
